prompt:
Build a beautiful native Android Voice Studio app.

Features:

- Text to Speech: type/paste text and speak it.
- Speak to Write: 🎙️ convert speech into editable text.
- Support all available device languages & voices.
- Voice, pitch and speech-speed controls.
- Play, pause, resume and stop.
- Export generated speech as MP3/audio and save locally.
- Audio history with play, share, rename and delete.
- Modern Material 3 UI, smooth animations, dark/light mode.
- Fully native, no WebView, no login, no external API.
- Handle permissions, unsupported voices and errors properly.

Make it polished, fast and production-ready.
